stem: What is one way the ideas from the English Bill of Rights are reflected in the U.S. system of government?

options.label: A
options.text: Power is divided between the national government and the states.

options.label: B
options.text: People have the right to establish and campaign for political parties.

options.label: C
options.text: Power is divided among three branches of government.

options.label: D
options.text: People have the right to petition the government for a redress of grievances.

visual_elements: 2025 – Q13, multiple choice answer options labeled A, B, C, D
